text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Chocolate… Chocolates, huh? Valentine's chocolates for Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Are you planning to make chocolate from scratch for your trainer, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Dia. Yeah, I was going to, but do you think they'll turn out good enough? My chocolates are nowhere near the pro level…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course they will! Even if they're not on par with a professional, the chocolates you make are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, this chocolate tastes amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It better! I worked really hard on them since I didn't want to lose out to the super high-quality stuff you give me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Trying to outdo you each year has definitely helped hone my skills.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's kind of embarrassing to give chocolates to anyone other than you, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can't let your shyness stop you, Kita! It's only right to give proper thanks to the person who's been taking care of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're always telling me how grateful you are for being able to run with confidence because your trainer's always by your side.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I feel that seasonal events like this are the best time to convey the depth of your feelings in the form of a gift!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The depth of my feelings. I see… You're right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is no time to be embarrassed! I owe so much to Trainer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this! I'm gonna make the best chocolates in the world!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I've reserved the gymnasium all to myself, so now I can focus on making a huge chocolate sculpture!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll have to figure out what kind of chocolate I want for the base first…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right, it should be dark to represent the ground and have a velvety creaminess to balance out the crunchiness of the snow pillars.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And to top it all off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Chocolate the color of pure snow! And this won't be just powder snow but a proper blizzard! The decorations have gotta look a little wild too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's complete! I've put all my feelings of gratitude into chocolate form!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer! Please accept my unmatched gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I call this "The Blizzard of the Northern Wasteland"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The chocolate sculpture she reveals looks straight out of an enka song. A wild blizzard of white chocolate rages atop a layer of dark chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It doesn't just look amazing, by the way! It tastes great too, so go ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't know if this is enough to show you just how thankful I really am, but please help yourself and eat away!
choice_data_list: Thank you! But, uh… This is kinda big, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I guess you're right. Things got a little out of control as I was making it…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But don't worry! Whatever you don't finish, I'll help bring up to your room. That's right! This chocolate comes with free delivery service!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I enjoy Kitasan Black's enka-themed chocolate creation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to her word, Kitasan Black brings the leftovers to my room. I certainly won't be in need of more chocolate for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I had a feeling that might be the case, so I made something else that's a little easier to eat.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I figured this would be easier to deal with. Erm… here you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the box to find a chocolate figure shaped like Kitasan Black inside.
choice_data_list: Why is it shaped like you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's supposed to be a joke… I'm Kitasan Black, so I decided it'd be funny to make something with black cocoa powder. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks to you, I've finally become the wonderful Umamusume I've always wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They're nothing fancy or anything, but I'm really proud of how rich they taste! Take your time and savor them!
choice_data_list: Thank you. By the way, what is this one called?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, since the big one there is called "The Blizzard of the Northern Wasteland"…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She pauses and thinks for a while before continuing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay, I've got it! This one is…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "The One I Can Never Forget"!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-you think so? I hear that a lot with my gifts. Guess I'm the type to go big or go home. Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With all said and done, the chocolates are a real delicacy. They're simple and sweet and fill my whole body with joy.
